## Context

The project "Bạn Học Toán AI" has extensive spec/planning docs but zero UI implementation. The frontend is a fresh Next.js 16 + Tailwind v4 boilerplate. The user needs a landing page that communicates the product vision — an AI visual math tutor for elementary students — to attract early users and demo the concept.

## Approach

Single-page landing with 6 sections, all content in Vietnamese. Server Components only (no `"use client"`) for maximum SEO. CSS-only scroll animations via a lightweight `<ScrollReveal>` client component using IntersectionObserver.

## Files to Create/Modify

| File | Action | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/layout.tsx` | Modify | Update metadata (title, description, OG tags, icons), set `lang="vi"` |
| `frontend/src/app/page.tsx` | Rewrite | Landing page with 6 sections |
| `frontend/src/app/globals.css` | Modify | Add brand colors, custom animations, scroll-reveal keyframes |
| `frontend/src/components/landing/Navbar.tsx` | Create | Sticky nav with logo + CTA |
| `frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx` | Create | Hero headline + subheadline + CTA |
| `frontend/src/components/landing/Problem.tsx` | Create | Pain point section |
| `frontend/src/components/landing/Features.tsx` | Create | 5 differentiators with icons |
| `frontend/src/components/landing/HowItWorks.tsx` | Create | Step-by-step learning flow |
| `frontend/src/components/landing/Topics.tsx` | Create | 4 math domains showcase |
| `frontend/src/components/landing/CTA.tsx` | Create | Final call-to-action |
| `frontend/src/components/landing/Footer.tsx` | Create | Simple footer |
| `frontend/src/components/shared/ScrollReveal.tsx` | Create | Client component for scroll-triggered fade-in |

## Section Structure (page.tsx)

```
<Navbar />         — sticky, transparent → solid on scroll
<Hero />           — "Hiểu Toán bằng cách nhìn, chạm và thử"
<Problem />        — Học sinh nhớ nhưng không hiểu
<Features />       — 5 giá trị khác biệt (icons + cards)

<Topics />         — 4 chủ đề MVP (visual cards)

<Footer />         — Copyright + links
